reason: The cited evidence shows SRO increases dislocation activation barriers (E1) and that SRO can exist in nanoparticles (E2), but none of the passages address diffusion activation barriers, coarsening suppression, or high-temperature stability in nanoalloys. The key mechanistic premise linking SRO to diffusion barriers is unsupported by the cited literature.
premises: SRO increases local diffusion activation barriers in CoCrFeMnNi
SRO suppresses coarsening and phase separation at high temperature
Disordered state has uniformly high atomic mobility leading to instability
SRO can be induced in nanoparticles by moderate annealing (~600 K)
SRO effects observed in bulk alloys translate to 5–20 nm nanoparticles
